meta.name: data-storytelling
meta.description: Transform data into compelling narratives using visualization, context, and persuasive structure. Use when presenting analytics to stakeholders, creating data reports, or building executive presentations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用数据讲出有说服力的故事
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在汇报中把数据讲得动人
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to make your data presentations more compelling.

howto.what: 帮你把原始数据组织成有结构的叙事——先给结论,再用数据、背景和图表支撑,最后落到行动建议,产出面向报告和演示的要点。
howto.when: 当你向高管或投资人做汇报、写数据报告,或准备季度业务回顾时适用。

say.text: 把这些季度数据讲成一个给高管看的故事
say.note: 按背景、冲突、结论的结构来组织

say.text: 帮我给这份分析报告写结论和行动建议
say.note: 先给洞察,再补数据支撑

say.text: 把这份数据改成面向非技术同事的演示要点
say.note: 少用术语,点明数字的含义

howto.what_en: Turns raw data into a structured narrative: setup, conflict, resolution. It leads with the key insight, backs it with numbers and visuals, and ends with clear next steps for reports and presentations.
howto.when_en: Use it when presenting analytics to executives, creating data reports, or building investor and quarterly review presentations.

say_en.text: Turn these quarterly numbers into a story for executives
say_en.note: Structure it as setup, conflict, resolution

say_en.text: Write the conclusion and action steps for this analytics report
say_en.note: Lead with the insight, then the data

say_en.text: Turn this data into presentation points for a non-technical audience
say_en.note: Cut jargon, spell out what the numbers mean
